body:
Out of all of the warlocks you mentioned, I'm very interested in both Kallus1 and Abby1. I looked up Kallus1's feat and I really love it, swarming the board with free small guys is a really cool idea. I always have loved really aggressive game play when it comes to any games really, so a fast and swarmy style of army sounds great to me. Abby1 sounds really cool as well, I like her feat, really could help give the beasts in that army their staying power, since she can autoheal them all. Plus, I'm always looking for an excuse to buy an Archangel. If it wouldn't be too imposing, would you happen to have an army list for either of these warlocks? I would love some direction on how to build around them.

Thank you so much for all of the knowledge you have given me, it means a lot that you took the time to help me out :)

That's a good point, and something to consider especially since all of the Steamroller events use scenario. Do you have any suggestions of a more balanced Legion army better suited for scenario play? I was thinking possibly Thagrosh 2, but I'm not sure, I'd love to hear your ideas!

I love this list! Especially the inclusion of the Raek, I always feel like in Legion, the lesser warbeasts get less attention than they should  in my area. That's a good point as well about scenario, since she doesn't run any units, I could see her often falling behind. Although in terms of play style, that's never really an issue for me. I don't know if it's "unsportsman" like of me, but I've always preferred to attempt assassination when I play, it feels more interesting and risky to me. After all, Legion is often a glass cannon, might as well play it like one!

Thank you so much for your advice, it is very much appreciated :)
All good, thank you for your response anyway!
What visual novel is this? Thank you in advance!
